label: Bible Study
prompt: Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and _____,
verse: Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped,
note: Job's first response to losing everything — grief, and then worship, before a single word.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall _____ him as he is.
verse: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.
note: We don't know everything about what we'll be — but we know we'll see Him as He is.

label: Sunday School
prompt: But she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of _____, which she had laid in order upon the roof.
verse: But she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the roof.
note: Rahab hid Joshua's spies on her roof under stalks of flax laid out to dry — then sent the king's men off on a wild goose chase.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to _____ God rather than men.
verse: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.
note: Arrested again and ordered to stop preaching, the apostles explained the chain of command to the council.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: The LORD will perfect that which _____ me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
verse: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
note: 'The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me' — he finishes what he starts, Philippians 1:6 in psalm form.
